review.readiness_note: Visual sign-off for this captured 390px review state. The capture exposes the relevant data, states and actions, but cannot verify Save persistence, inspection destinations, navigation behavior or backend review transitions.
review.why: This is a faithful purpose-specific translation, not a misplaced copy of the Home layout. The offset Story sheet, compact cobalt amount edge, mineral background and unboxed terms retain the approved silhouette. Longer real content wraps without visible truncation, and both supplied creative and proof remain separately inspectable. The financial arithmetic is consistent, approval remains explicitly conditional, manual eligibility confirmation is named, and no control implies that proof has already been approved or earnings credited.
review.verdict: Yes—Frame Shift is faithfully transferred to this 390px Story review detail, with the real functionality visibly preserved and no release-blocking visual drift.
